dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: The Chasm mines have been closed due to an accident. Mine workers can come to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs and present valid documentation to apply for and claim temporary unemployment, medical, and food stipends.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Shops adversely affected by the closure of the mines can come to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs to apply for tax exemptions and deductions.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When will the mines reopen? If they will be closed for an extended period, I won't be able to afford my room in Yujing Terrace..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Please do not fret. Wait for the Qixing's announcement on the exact time of reopening.
